notes.title: Realm Royale Supported
notes.notes:
Hi folks! Due to popular demand, we've added support for Realm Royale.		

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/813820/Realm_Royale/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/813820/extras/RealmRoyale_-_Class_-_ENG.png?t=1528772784[/img][/url]
Explore a fantasy world in Realm Royale, the new Battle Royale inspired by the hit game Paladins. Are you an Assassin, a Warrior or a Mage? Choose your class, then loot fantastic weapons and magical abilities to create your own Champion. Stay ahead of the deadly fog by mounting up and moving out. Will you be the last Champion standing?

See you in Goblin Gulch...

[url=https://www.caffeine.tv/start-broadcasting][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/865770/extras/banner-steam.png?t=1528879498[/img][/url]
